## Data Preparation

```{r}

#| error: false

library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)
library(patchwork)
library(ggside)
library(ggdist)
library(brms)
library(cogmod)

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores() - 2)

df <- read.csv("../data/data_participants.csv")
```


```{r}
m_beauty <- readRDS("models/Beauty.rds")
```




## Individual Parameters

```{r}

m <- m_beauty
data <- get_data(m)

get_grouplevel <- function(m, outcome = "Beauty") {
  df_individual <- data.frame()
  batches <- split(unique(data$Participant),  ceiling(seq_along(unique(data$Participant)) / 50))
  for(batch in 1:length(batches)) {
    cat("\nProcessing batch ", batch, " of ", length(batches), "...\n")
    data_subset <- data[data$Participant %in% batches[[batch]], ]
    
    params <- c("response", "mu", insight::find_auxiliary(m))
    params <- params[!params %in% c("pex", "bex", "pmid")]
    
    for(p in params) {
      cat(".")
      c_baseline <- estimate_means(m, by = c("Participant", "Condition"), 
                                   backend = "marginaleffects", iterations = 100,  
                                   data = data_subset, test = NULL, ci = NULL, 
                                   dispersion = TRUE, predict = p) |>
        filter(Condition == "Human Original") |>
        mutate(Parameter = paste0("Baseline_", str_replace(p, "response", "resp"))) |>
        select(Participant, Parameter, Median, MAD)
      
      
      c_condition <- estimate_contrasts(m, contrast = "Condition", by = c("Participant"), 
                                        backend = "marginaleffects", iterations = 100, 
                                        data = data_subset, test = NULL, ci = NULL,
                                        dispersion = TRUE, predict = p) |>
      mutate(Level1 = case_when(Level1 == "AI-Generated" ~ "AI",
                                Level1 == "Human Original" ~ "Ori",
                                .default = "Forg"),
             Level2 = case_when(Level2== "AI-Generated" ~ "AI",
                                Level2 == "Human Original" ~ "Ori",
                                .default = "Forg"), 
             Parameter = paste0(Level1, Level2, "_", str_replace(p, "response", "resp"))) |> 
      select(Participant, Parameter, Median, MAD)
      
      df_individual <- bind_rows(df_individual, c_baseline, c_condition)
    }
  }
  df_individual$Outcome <- outcome
}




```


### Feature Reduction

```{r}
df_wide <- df_individual |> 
  select(-MAD) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Parameter", values_from = c("Median"))

nfac <- n_factors(select(df_wide, -Participant))
plot(nfac)

rez <- factor_analysis(select(df_wide, -Participant), n = 4)
plot(rez)
```

```{r}
df_wide |>
  correlation(p_adjust = "none", redundant = TRUE) |>
  cor_sort() |>
  mutate(Sig = ifelse(p < .05, "Significant", "N.S.")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=Parameter1, y=Parameter2)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = r, alpha = Sig)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#1D9AF5", mid = "white", high = "#F51D56", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Significant" = 1, "N.S." = 1)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Correlates

```{r}
df_all <- full_join(df, df_wide, by = "Participant")

```

```{r}
select(df, ManipulationDistrust,
       BAIT_ArtRealistic, BAIT_Positive, BAIT_Negative, BAIT_Total,
       starts_with("MINT"), -MINT_AttentionCheck) |>
  correlation(data2 = df_wide, p_adjust = "none") |>
  cor_sort() |>
  mutate(Sig = ifelse(p < .05, "Significant", "N.S.")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=Parameter1, y=Parameter2)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = r, alpha = Sig)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#1D9AF5", mid = "white", high = "#F51D56", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Significant" = 1, "N.S." = 0.2)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
